description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_firebird' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' and provides methods for handling Firebird database schema operations, including type mapping, quoting, creating databases, managing sequences, creating tables, triggers, and altering columns.

classes.name: ADODB2_firebird
classes.description: A class for Firebird database schema management extending ADODB_DataDict.

methods.name: actualType
methods.description: Maps meta types to Firebird-specific data types.

methods.name: nameQuote
methods.description: Quotes database object names appropriately for Firebird.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Generates SQL to declare external functions for Firebird.

methods.name: _dropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop auto-increment sequences.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix for column definitions based on attributes.

methods.name: createTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to create a table with fields and indexes.

methods.name: _triggers
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating or replacing sequences and triggers for auto-increment.

methods.name: alterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to alter a column's definition.
